name: Apprenticeship — Legacy Completed (AY 25/26), Same Then Different Provider POST Course 2 (AY 26/27)
description: Provider A's apprenticeship (standard 21) is a 'legacy' record: created directly by Commitments' ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent, never a draft — starts 2024-08-01 (AY 24/25) with a planned EndDate of 2026-07-31 (the last day of AY 25/26), a near-two-year standard. Provider A then completes it via PUT on 2026-06-01, a couple of months ahead of the original planned end but still within AY 25/26 — via the legacy PUT route (/providers/{ukprn}/learning/{learnerKey}), no academicYear param needed since it's still AY 25/26. Provider A then POSTs a draft for a different course (standard 91) starting in AY 26/27, via the new-style route (/providers/{ukprn}/apprenticeships?academicYear=2627) rather than the legacy /learners route, since this POST is for the next academic year. Provider B then POSTs a draft for the same learner and same course (standard 91), also starting in AY 26/27, via the same new-style route. Checks CreateDraftApprenticeshipLearningCommandHandler.Handle's GetAllByLearnerKey(learner.Key, ukprn, courseCode) lookup across three dimensions at once: a completed prior-course row is not matched by course code, and Provider A's own course-2 draft is not matched by Provider B's UKPRN — so three independent ApprenticeshipLearning rows should exist: the completed standard-21 row, Provider A's unapproved standard-91 draft, and Provider B's unapproved standard-91 draft.

steps.name: Commitments Approves an Apprenticeship (Provider A, Standard 21, Never a Draft, Start 2024-08-01, Planned End 2026-07-31)
SLD (Provider A) Records Completion, Standard 21, Within AY 25/26
SLD (Provider A) Creates a Draft Apprenticeship, Standard 91, AY 26/27
SLD (Provider B) Creates a Draft Apprenticeship, Standard 91, Same Learner, AY 26/27

assertions.name: Three separate ApprenticeshipLearning rows exist for the learner
One approved episode (completed standard 21), two unapproved drafts (standard 91 x2)
